title: Option to show OSDs on all monitors
line: A new "Show OSD popups: On all screens" option in General Behavior shows volume, brightness and other OSDs, and the Meta+P display selector, on every screen.
explanation: Plasma's OSDs were a single window that KWin always places on the active screen (the one with the pointer), and the Meta+P display selector in kscreen picked one screen too, so on a multi-screen setup they were easy to miss, or invisible when that screen showed nothing. There was no way to change this. plasmashell now reads a new ShowOnAllScreens key in plasmarc's [OSD] group and, when it's set, keeps one OSD window per screen and positions each like KWin does (centered, at two thirds of the height of the available area); the kscreen selector opens on every enabled screen with the same key, and the General Behavior page gets an "On all screens" checkbox for it. The kscreen change also passes the screen to layer-shell-qt, because Qt reset each selector window to the screen at 0,0 on creation, which put every copy on the same screen.

commits.message:
shell/osd: Optionally show OSDs on all screens

OSDs only ever appeared on the active screen, so they were easy to miss
while looking at another one. With ShowOnAllScreens set in the OSD group
of plasmarc, plasmashell now places a copy of the OSD on every screen.

BUG: 507695

kcms/workspaceoptions: Add option to show OSD popups on all screens

Popups for status changes like volume or brightness could only appear on
the active screen. Add a checkbox for the new ShowOnAllScreens setting,
which shows them on every screen while OSD popups are enabled.

BUG: 507695

osd: Show the display configuration selector on all screens if asked

The selector appeared on one screen only, and always the one at 0,0 as
Qt resets a new window's screen from its geometry. Follow the OSD option
ShowOnAllScreens in plasmarc and pass the screen to layer shell as well.

BUG: 507695

patches.diff:
From 5c1a7f5a3ec8f42e9b5f977324a6d490e293aa85 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:33:29 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] kcms/workspaceoptions: Add option to show OSD popups on all
 screens

Popups for status changes like volume or brightness could only appear on
the active screen. Add a checkbox for the new ShowOnAllScreens setting,
which shows them on every screen while OSD popups are enabled.

BUG: 507695
---
 kcms/workspaceoptions/ui/main.qml                 | 15 +++++++++++++++
 .../workspaceoptions_plasmasettings.kcfg          |  5 +++++
 2 files changed, 20 insertions(+)

diff --git a/kcms/workspaceoptions/ui/main.qml b/kcms/workspaceoptions/ui/main.qml
index 13c6b17741..2e28cb1cc7 100644
--- a/kcms/workspaceoptions/ui/main.qml
+++ b/kcms/workspaceoptions/ui/main.qml
@@ -81,6 +81,21 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
                     toolTipText: i18nc("@info:whatsthis contextualhelpbutton tooltip", "Allows all Plasma widgets to show on-screen display (OSD) popups for changes like volume and brightness level, or audio device switching.")
                 }
             }
+
+            Kirigami.FormEntry {
+                title: i18nc("@label:checkbox part of a complete sentence: 'Show OSD popups on all screens'", "Show OSD popups:")
+                contentItem: QQC2.CheckBox {
+                    text: i18nc("@option:check part of a complete sentence: 'Show OSD popups on all screens'", "On all screens")
+                    checked: kcm.plasmaSettings.osdShowOnAllScreens
+                    onToggled: kcm.plasmaSettings.osdShowOnAllScreens = checked
+
+                    KCM.SettingStateBinding {
+                        configObject: kcm.plasmaSettings
+                        settingName: "osdShowOnAllScreens"
+                        extraEnabledConditions: osdDisablerCheckbox.checked
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
 
 
diff --git a/kcms/workspaceoptions/workspaceoptions_plasmasettings.kcfg b/kcms/workspaceoptions/workspaceoptions_plasmasettings.kcfg
index 253d25e14a..e646af36e1 100644
--- a/kcms/workspaceoptions/workspaceoptions_plasmasettings.kcfg
+++ b/kcms/workspaceoptions/workspaceoptions_plasmasettings.kcfg
@@ -17,6 +17,11 @@
       <tooltip>Allow Plasma widgets to display small popups for status changes such as brightness or volume</tooltip>
       <default>true</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="osdShowOnAllScreens" key="ShowOnAllScreens" type="Bool">
+      <label>Show popups for status changes on all screens</label>
+      <tooltip>Show popups for status changes such as brightness or volume on every screen instead of only the active one</tooltip>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="osdKbdLayoutChangedEnabled" key="kbdLayoutChangedEnabled" type="Bool">
       <label>OSD on layout change</label>
       <tooltip>Show a popup on layout changes</tooltip>
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Two screens, volume changed with the pointer on the left one: the OSD only appears on the left screen
With "On all screens" enabled: the volume OSD appears on both screens
Meta+P display selector: only on one screen
With the option: the selector appears on both screens (Escape or a choice closes both)
General Behavior: only an on/off switch for OSD popups
New "Show OSD popups: On all screens" checkbox (off by default, disabled when OSD popups are off)
